responsibilities: Meeting with business stakeholders to understand data needs and translate requirements into user stories and technical specifications
Modelling complex retail data in Databricks using SQL to create data marts, warehouse structures and reusable data assets

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Testing and validating data products, including your own code and work delivered by Data Engineers, to ensure quality and consistency
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: An entire responsibility bullet is given over to testing and validation 'to ensure quality and consistency', and no speed or shipping language appears anywhere in the posting.
evidence.domain_risk: Alinta Energy is one of Australia's biggest energy retailers, generators and developers with over 1.1 million customers.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A large energy retailer where the analytics guides retail strategy and business decisions, but the JD invokes no regulatory reporting, audit or compliance obligation on the role itself.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Join our Retail Insights team and help transform complex data into trusted products that guide business decisions.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named insights team with Databricks already in use, separate Data Engineers delivering work, and legacy reporting to migrate - an existing function being modernised rather than founded.
evidence.jd_authorship: Modelling complex retail data in Databricks using SQL to create data marts, warehouse structures and reusable data assets
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name the platform and the artefacts precisely - Databricks, data marts, warehouse structures, Power BI dashboards - and the requirements go down to star schemas, CDC and SCD.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Build trusted data products that shape retail strategy and decisions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is the commercial side of the business - retail strategy, customer personalisation and the Retail Insights team's business stakeholders.
evidence.autonomy_level: Meeting with business stakeholders to understand data needs and translate requirements into user stories and technical specifications
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role receives scoped requirements and delivers against them - 'Supporting the migration', 'Building and contributing to' - and the JD promises 'clear direction' rather than direction-setting.
evidence.ai_role: with support to build capability across predictive analytics, customer personalisation and emerging technology
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Predictive analytics and 'emerging technology' are offered as growth areas, not AI skills expected of the candidate, and no AI tooling or AI-facing data work is named.
evidence.testing_framing: Testing and validating data products, including your own code and work delivered by Data Engineers, to ensure quality and consistency
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is an owned responsibility extending to reviewing other engineers' output, not a tool listed in the skills section.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Join our Retail Insights team and help transform complex data into trusted products that guide business decisions.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust is the role's headline framing and recurs alongside 'ensure quality and consistency' and 'managing risks' - the fear is untrustworthy products guiding retail strategy.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Supporting the migration of legacy reporting while managing risks, change activities and regular stakeholder updates.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role creates new data marts, pipelines and dashboards while simultaneously modernising and migrating legacy reporting.
evidence.work_arrangement: Grow into predictive analytics | Hybrid work | Energy discounts
evidence.loss_aversion: Testing and validating data products, including your own code and work delivered by Data Engineers, to ensure quality and consistency - the risk being controlled is inconsistent or wrong data products reaching retail decision-makers during a legacy reporting migration.
